title: 台式机主板的 CPU 核心供电
title_en: CPU core power on the desktop mainboard
summary: 12 V 降到约 1.1 V、最大 140 A 给 CPU：比较 4 / 6 / 8 相选 6 相，算纹波、损耗与效率、负载线和输出电容，ngspice 开关仿真核对纹波和导通损耗、平均模型看 100 A 负载阶跃，电压公差叠加算出核心电压散布，写回工厂数据；SMT 线做 40 块、上电测试。
summary_en: 12 V down to about 1.1 V at up to 140 A for the CPU: 4 / 6 / 8 phases compared and 6 chosen; ripple, losses, efficiency, load line and output capacitors calculated; ngspice switching simulation for ripple and conduction loss, averaged model for a 100 A load step; tolerance stack gives the core-voltage spread used by the plant; 40 boards built and tested.
honest: 示例设计：经计算和仿真校核，没有实物试制；数值为示例值。
honest_en: Example design: checked by calculation and simulation, not built and tested; all values are examples.

steps.title: 任务书
steps.summary: 12 V → 约 1.1 V，最大 140 A；负载线 1.1 mΩ；阶跃 30 → 130 A；偏离负载线 ±15 mV。
steps.summary_en: 12 V to about 1.1 V, up to 140 A; 1.1 mΩ load line; 30 → 130 A step; ±15 mV around the load line.

steps.title: 方案
steps.summary: 6 相（100 A 时效率 92.4 %）；智能功率级测电流；自适应电压定位（AVP）。
steps.summary_en: 6 phases (92.4 % at 100 A); current sensed in smart power stages; adaptive voltage positioning (AVP).

steps.title: 计算
steps.summary_en: 9.4 W loss, 92.4 % efficiency at 100 A; ≥ 3.54 mF needed (3.76 mF chosen); tolerance stack 3σ = 6.5 mV.

steps.title: 仿真
steps.summary: 开关仿真与公式：纹波相差 3.9 %、导通损耗相差 0.2 %；负载阶跃：6 只聚合物电容偏离负载线 0.0 mV，少 20 % 电容 0.0 mV。
steps.summary_en: Switching sim vs formulas: ripple within 3.9 %, conduction loss within 0.2 %; load step: 0.0 mV off the load line with 6 polymer caps, 0.0 mV with 20 % less capacitance.

figs.caption: 六相电流交错、负载阶跃、电容只数与过冲
figs.caption_en: Interleaved phase currents, load step, capacitor count vs deviation

files.label: 负载阶跃平均模型网表

steps.title: 三维与图纸
steps.summary: 插座左侧 3 相、上方 3 相；功率级 → 电感 → 插座一条直线；陶瓷电容放插座背面；远端差分采样。
steps.summary_en: Three phases left of the socket, three above; power stage → inductor → socket in a straight line; ceramics behind the socket; remote differential sensing.

steps.title: 工艺
steps.summary: 主板 SMT 线 11 道：功率级大焊盘网格开孔、X 光看空洞、上电测试量核心电压偏差、BIOS 写控制器参数。
steps.summary_en: 11 SMT operations: grid stencil for the power-stage pads, X-ray for voids, power-on test of core-voltage deviation, controller settings with the BIOS.

steps.title: 制造
steps.summary: 40 块：核心电压偏差 σ 2.21 mV（预计 2.17），不合格 0，最低 Cpk 1.34。
steps.summary_en: 40 boards: core-voltage deviation σ 2.21 mV (predicted 2.17); 0 failures, lowest Cpk 1.34.

steps.title: 总结
steps.summary: 10 / 10 项校核通过；6 相、效率 92.4 %、电容 3.76 mF、电压 3σ 6.5 mV。
steps.summary_en: 10 / 10 checks pass; 6 phases, 92.4 % efficiency, 3.76 mF, voltage 3σ 6.5 mV.
